text: 【央行副行长陶玲：将继续支持金融机构开展人民币境外贷款和跨境贸易融资】中国人民银行副行长陶玲16日在全球财富管理论坛·2026上海苏河湾大会上表示，下一步，为了进一步满足离岸市场人民币流动性需求，我们将继续支持金融机构开展人民币境外贷款和跨境贸易融资，完善银行跨境同业人民币融资政策，鼓励更多境外机构参与熊猫债的发行和交易，支持香港发展人民币点心债市场。
text_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Tao Ling: Will continue to support financial institutions in conducting RMB overseas loans and cross-border trade financing] Tao Ling, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, said on the 16th at the Global Wealth Management Forum·2026 Shanghai Suhewan Conference that next, in order to further meet offshore market demand for RMB liquidity, we will continue to support financial institutions in conducting RMB overseas loans and cross-border trade financing, improve policies for banks' cross-border interbank RMB financing, encourage more overseas institutions to participate in the issuance and trading of panda bonds, and support Hong Kong in developing the RMB dim sum bond market.
